nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c) - checked addition helper
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c) - checked subtraction helper
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c) - checked multiplication helper
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c) - checked division helper
address public owner - privileged owner address of the contract
address public newOwner - pending owner used in two-step ownership transfer
Owned constructor - sets owner = msg.sender
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner - stages a new owner
acceptOwnership() public - completes ownership transfer if msg.sender == newOwner
modifier onlyOwner - requires msg.sender == owner, access control gate
string public symbol - token symbol PGT
string public name - token name Pegasus Token
uint8 public decimals - token decimals (0)
uint public _totalSupply - total token supply (1000000000000)
mapping(address => uint) balances - token balance ledger
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed - ERC20 allowance ledger
PegasusToken constructor - initializes metadata and mints the total supply
totalSupply() public constant returns (uint) - returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)]
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) public constant returns (uint balance) - reads balances mapping
transfer(address to, uint tokens) public returns (bool success) - moves tokens from msg.sender
approve(address spender, uint tokens) public returns (bool success) - sets allowance for msg.sender
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) public returns (bool success) - spends allowance
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) public constant returns (uint remaining)
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) public returns (bool success) - approve plus external callback
function () public payable - fallback that always reverts, refuses ETH
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) public onlyOwner - owner rescues arbitrary ERC20 via external call
msg.sender used in the Owned constructor to assign owner
msg.sender used in approve as the allowance owner key
msg.sender used in transferFrom as the spender key in allowed[from][msg.sender]
msg.sender used in approveAndCall both as allowance owner key and as argument to the external callback
msg.sender used in transfer as the debited account
msg.sender used in the onlyOwner modifier and in acceptOwnership access checks
unsigned addition c = a + b in safeAdd; guarded only by the require(c >= a) check
unsigned subtraction c = a - b in safeSub; guarded only by the require(b <= a) check
unsigned multiplication c = a * b in safeMul; guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
unsigned division c = a / b in safeDiv; guarded by require(b > 0)
external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) - arbitrary contract invocation
external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an attacker-supplied token address
uint a - first operand of safeAdd
uint b - second operand of safeAdd
uint c - result local of safeAdd
uint a - first operand of safeSub
uint b - second operand of safeSub
uint c - result local of safeSub
uint a - first operand of safeMul
uint b - second operand of safeMul
uint c - result local of safeMul
uint a - numerator of safeDiv
uint b - denominator of safeDiv
uint c - result local of safeDiv
address tokenOwner - account queried in balanceOf
address to - recipient of transfer
uint tokens - amount moved in transfer
address spender - allowance grantee in approve
uint tokens - allowance amount in approve
address from - debited account in transferFrom
address to - credited account in transferFrom
uint tokens - amount moved in transferFrom
address spender - allowance grantee and external callee in approveAndCall
uint tokens - allowance amount in approveAndCall
bytes data - arbitrary payload forwarded to the external receiveApproval call
address tokenAddress - caller-supplied contract used as external callee
uint tokens - amount forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer
address _newOwner - staged owner in transferOwnership
address tokenOwner - allowance owner key in allowance
address spender - allowance spender key in allowance

edges.reason: safeAdd body executes the unchecked unsigned addition
safeAdd parameter a is an operand of c = a + b, an overflow-capable addition
safeAdd parameter b is an operand of c = a + b, an overflow-capable addition
result of the addition is assigned to the local c in safeAdd
safeSub body executes the unchecked unsigned subtraction
safeSub parameter a is the minuend of c = a - b, an underflow-capable subtraction
safeSub parameter b is the subtrahend of c = a - b
result of the subtraction is assigned to the local c in safeSub
safeMul body executes the unchecked unsigned multiplication
safeMul parameter a is an operand of c = a * b, an overflow-capable multiplication
safeMul parameter b is an operand of c = a * b
result of the multiplication is assigned to the local c in safeMul
safeDiv body executes the unsigned division
safeDiv parameter a is the numerator of c = a / b
safeDiv parameter b is the denominator of c = a / b and is only guarded by require(b > 0)
result of the division is assigned to the local c in safeDiv
Owned constructor reads the untrusted msg.sender
owner is initialized directly from msg.sender, granting the deployer full privileges
onlyOwner modifier evaluates the untrusted msg.sender
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the owner state variable to authorize privileged calls
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier
caller-supplied _newOwner is written into the privileged newOwner state variable
acceptOwnership evaluates the untrusted msg.sender
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner and then promotes msg.sender to owner
constructor assigns the symbol state variable
constructor assigns the name state variable
constructor assigns the decimals state variable
constructor assigns the _totalSupply state variable
constructor mints the entire supply into balances of a hardcoded address
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply
balanceOf binds the tokenOwner parameter
tokenOwner is used as the key into the balances mapping
transfer binds the to parameter
transfer binds the tokens parameter
transfer calls safeSub on the sender balance
transfer calls safeAdd on the recipient balance
msg.sender balance is debited by the amount of tokens
tokens parameter is the quantity subtracted from the sender balance
to parameter is credited in the balances mapping
tokens parameter is the quantity added to the recipient balance
approve binds the spender parameter
approve binds the tokens parameter
msg.sender is used as the owner key of the allowed mapping
spender is used as the spender key of the allowed mapping
tokens is the allowance value written into the allowed mapping without a double-spend check
transferFrom binds the from parameter
transferFrom binds the to parameter
transferFrom binds the tokens parameter
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance debits
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient credit
from is the debited key in the balances mapping
msg.sender is the spender key decremented in allowed[from][msg.sender]
to is the credited key in the balances mapping
tokens amount drives the safeSub debits in transferFrom
tokens amount drives the safeAdd credit in transferFrom
allowance binds the tokenOwner parameter
allowance binds the spender parameter
tokenOwner is the outer key read from the allowed mapping
spender is the inner key read from the allowed mapping
approveAndCall binds the spender parameter
approveAndCall binds the tokens parameter
approveAndCall binds the data parameter
approveAndCall performs the external receiveApproval call
msg.sender is the owner key written into the allowed mapping before the external call
msg.sender is forwarded as the from argument of the untrusted external receiveApproval call
caller-controlled spender determines which arbitrary contract is invoked
caller-controlled bytes data is forwarded verbatim into the external callback
the external contract can re-enter the token contract through any exposed function while approveAndCall is still executing
transferAnyERC20Token binds the tokenAddress parameter
transferAnyERC20Token binds the tokens parameter
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on a caller-supplied token contract
tokenAddress is the callee of the external transfer call and can be an attacker contract
tokens amount is forwarded to the external transfer against the owner destination
external call is instructed to send the rescued tokens to the owner address

normalization_plan.reason: operand parameter a of safeAdd is only meaningful as input to the addition operation
operand parameter b of safeAdd is only meaningful as input to the addition operation
local c of safeAdd holds the arithmetic result and adds no independent semantics
operand parameter a of safeSub feeds only the subtraction operation
operand parameter b of safeSub feeds only the subtraction operation
local c of safeSub is the arithmetic result carrier
operand parameter a of safeMul feeds only the multiplication operation
operand parameter b of safeMul feeds only the multiplication operation
local c of safeMul is the arithmetic result carrier
numerator parameter a of safeDiv feeds only the division operation
denominator parameter b of safeDiv feeds only the division operation
local c of safeDiv is the arithmetic result carrier
tokenOwner parameter is bound solely by balanceOf
to parameter is bound solely by transfer
tokens parameter is bound solely by transfer
spender parameter is bound solely by approve
tokens parameter is bound solely by approve
from parameter is bound solely by transferFrom
to parameter is bound solely by transferFrom
tokens parameter is bound solely by transferFrom

tokens parameter is bound solely by approveAndCall
data parameter exists only to be forwarded into the untrusted receiveApproval external call
tokenAddress parameter exists only to select the callee of the external ERC20 transfer call
tokens parameter exists only to size the external ERC20 transfer call
_newOwner parameter is bound solely by transferOwnership
tokenOwner parameter is bound solely by allowance
spender parameter is bound solely by allowance
